correctness.rationale: The orthogonal signed cycle has spectrum all odd roots of t^(2p)+1. Under the normal order-p subgroup precisely one complex character line is fixed and all remaining lines are free away from zero; the sphere-join quotient is exactly S1*L, 2-connected. The complementary C4 action is free by the stabilizer classification. Hurewicz gives pi3=Cp and connected torus isotopy gives trivial deck action. Transfer localized at p and at 2 yields complementary Cp and C4 torsion, hence C4p in odd degrees. Full p=3 quotient chain test checks d^2=0 and F2,F3,F5,F7 Betti counts. The finite test does not replace general proof.

value.rationale: The geometric universal-cover homeomorphism exhibits a sharply distinguished natural infinite family of singular Coxeter orbit spaces with 2-connected noncontractible universal covers and unbounded-order third homotopy groups; it identifies the precise residual finite deck action. This is a structural topological classification not recoverable from the prior generic calculation of the quotient's ordinary homology alone. The B6 case is the first singular example in this even-rank family, and finite checks address its nontrivial mod-primary homology. This contribution is limited to the universal cover and low Postnikov data, not a complete orbit-space homotopy classification.
